title: Internal: Courtesy Adjustments for Late Payment Fees
content:
## Overview

Cardholders who were charged a late payment fee may ask for it to be removed. Agents may grant one courtesy adjustment per credit card account in any rolling 12-month period.

## Eligibility

- The late payment fee posted within the last 60 days.
- No courtesy late fee adjustment was applied to the same account in the past 12 months. Prior adjustments appear in the card's transaction history as a Rho-Bank Statement Credit.
- The account is not closed.

## Adjustment Amount

- Standard: credit the full amount of the late payment fee.
- Bronze Rewards Card: courtesy adjustments are limited to $25.00 per request. When the fee is higher than $25.00, credit $25.00.

## Processing

1. Locate the fee in the customer's credit card transactions.
2. Confirm eligibility as described above.
3. Apply the adjustment with apply_statement_credit_8472, reason 'late_fee_reversal', amount as determined above.
4. Let the customer know the credit will appear on their next statement.
